records.text: Owens reported that the veteran's wife said removing a brain clot ended his need for a hearing aid, his headaches, and his morning hemoptysis.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: His wife told me that once they removed that clot from his brain, all of the other issues that he was having cleared up. So he, unbeknownst to me, was wearing a hearing aid and now he doesn't need to wear his hearing aid. ... He was having headaches. Now he's not having headaches. He was spitting up blood in the morning.
